title.en: Printed-row question: Which published pump fits a grid-powered building pour
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：有电网的建筑浇筑，先看哪类已公布泵

description.en: On a building site with stable power, start on the electric catalogue, not a diesel row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints building and commercial placement on Electric 20 through Electric 60, the low-pressure 40 and 60, and HBT80-16. Electric 80 and HBT8018 are the high-rise and high-output rows. Read metres, stone and m³/h on the model page.
description.zh: 供电稳定的建筑工地，先打开电动目录，而不是柴油行。河北品锦机械（邢台）把建筑与商业浇筑写在电动20到电动60、低压40、低压60和 HBT80-16 上。电动80与 HBT8018 是高层和大排量行。米数、石子和 m³/h 以型号页为准。本页不把楼层换算成米，也不写楼名。电网稳定时，建筑浇筑是否先选柴油泵？不是。建筑页指向电动拖泵。柴油行公布给电网不稳的工地，包括农村与基建浇筑。本页会把层数换成垂直米数吗？

question.en: Is a diesel pump the first building choice when the grid is stable, under the outline “Etymology”?
question.zh: 在“词源”这一节里，电网稳定时，建筑浇筑是否先选柴油泵？

answer.en: No. The building pages point at electric trailer pumps. Diesel rows are published for sites without stable grid power, including rural and infrastructure placement.
answer.zh: 不是。建筑页指向电动拖泵。柴油行公布给电网不稳的工地，包括农村与基建浇筑。

question.en: Does this page turn storeys into vertical metres, under the outline “History”?
question.zh: 在“沿革”这一节里，本页会把层数换成垂直米数吗？

answer.en: No. Match the vertical cell printed on the model. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not add a floor-height formula on this note.
answer.zh: 不会。对照型号上印出的垂直格。河北品锦机械不在本页另编层高公式。

question.en: Are catalogue m³/h figures a daily pour promise, under the outline “Composition”?
question.zh: 在“组成”这一节里，目录里的 m³/h 是日浇筑承诺吗？

answer.en: No. They are theoretical output cells. A jobsite rate still depends on the mix arriving at the hopper.
answer.zh: 不是。它们是理论输送量格子。工地速率仍取决于到达料斗的料。
